title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
script:
Replit has officially replaced Anthropic with OpenAI as its default model provider.
CEO Amjad Masad announced this shift during the TechCrunch Disrupt event this week.
OpenAI now powers the core coding experience for all Replit users.
Anthropic's Claude remains accessible as an alternative model within the platform interface.
The company previously relied on Anthropic to drive its automated coding features.
Users can still toggle between different intelligence providers for their specific tasks.
Would you choose OpenAI over Claude for your own coding projects?
